HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONCLAD.0.ancien: So you actually made it, blind beast. Without my Hextech, how did you drag yourself this far?
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.IRONCLAD.2.ancien: ...That piece. [jitter]It is on none of my blueprints.[/jitter]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.SILENT.0.ancient: Still silent? No matter. I am merely curious—how did you make it here with empty hands?
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.SILENT.1.ancient: ...Hold. That piece in your hand bears no mark of mine.
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.SILENT.2.ancient: You touched nothing along the way, only to carry that to the summit. [jitter]...Step back.[/jitter]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.DEFECT.0.ancient: A heap of scrap. Without my Hextech, what kept your core circuits running all the way to the top?
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.DEFECT.2.ancient: ...More noise. No, this string... [jitter]I never wrote this into the Spire.[/jitter]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.NECROBINDER.0.cha: You killed my parents, my friends, and took my life...
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.NECROBINDER.1.anc: I only did what was necessary. Even the strength behind your vengeance was my handout.
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.NECROBINDER.2.cha: So I threw away every scrap you handed me. [b]This time, I climbed with empty hands.[/b]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.NECROBINDER.3.anc: Preposterous. Without the path I laid... [jitter]hold. That piece in your grip bears no mark of my hand.[/jitter]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.REGENT.0.ancient: Spare me your royal airs. Within this Spire, I alone dictate the rules.
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.REGENT.1.char: A mere artisan sketches a few blueprints, and fancies himself the king at the board?
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.REGENT.2.ancient: Without my Hextech, you could never have... [jitter]wait. The piece you bear was never drawn by my hand.[/jitter]
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.GENERIC.0.ancient: An unmapped variable... and you still dared climb to the summit with empty hands?
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.GENERIC.1.ancient: ...Hold. That piece you carry holds no power at all.
HEXTECH_ARCHITECT.talk.GENERIC.2.ancient: Nor is it on any blueprint of mine. [jitter]...Impossible.[/jitter]
